svg.text: PK = primary key · FK = foreign key · 1 / 0..* = cardinality · dashed = matched by value at runtime, not a stored link
Generic Nostr software: no agents, no topics, no sessions
nikopi5 has one, friend's laptop has its own — never shared, never uploaded
How an incoming event finds its session
Sessions exist ONLY in ROUTE on each machine. The relay stores EVENT + TAG and nothing else.
